column4: 'sad' is not a meaning of the noun rouwkleur; the only real meaning is already listed in the other entry.
The literal clanging of sabres is the same word as the sabre-rattling entry and duplicates it, so keep the one with the figurative meaning.
Xanten is a place name wrongly listed as a common word, and the santen noun is already covered by the coconut milk entry.
The 'lesbian' sense is a duplicate of the Sapphic meanings, which already cover it, so this entry adds nothing.
This 'Sapphic' sense duplicates the other listed meaning 'Sapphic (pertaining to Sappho)'.
Water strider is the insect called schaatsenrijder in Dutch only in a rare sense and would confuse a learner; the skater meaning covers it.
'part of a chain' duplicates 'metal ring' (a chain link) listed as the other meaning.
A 'platform' sense is vague and overlaps with the ramp/fortification senses, so it only confuses learners.
Dutch 'scheel' does not mean 'sour' (that would be 'zuur'), so this meaning does not exist.
A noun 'het scheel' meaning eyelid does not exist in modern Dutch (that is 'ooglid'), and it duplicates the lid meaning.
'het scheel' meaning 'lid' is not a real modern Dutch noun; it is obscure and confusing for learners.
'Measure of volume' is an obscure archaic meaning that only confuses a learner.
'Scheel' as mesentery is obscure/dubious and the other listed meanings (lid, eyelid, volume measure) are archaic; it only confuses a learner.
Archaic 'cupbearer' is obscure and the meaning is different from donor, so it only confuses a learner; the donor sense is kept as item 2.
Ripcord is the term for a parachute cord (trekkoord), not scheurlijn, and the real meaning is covered by the tear line entry.
Archaic, obscure word whose senses (beam of light, cincinnus, dart) only confuse learners; the meaning is also duplicated across entries.
Archaic, obscure sense that duplicates the other schicht entries and would only confuse learners.
Archaic word; 'abrupt' is a near-duplicate of 'swift' and obscure for learners, so keep only one sense.
Rare neuter noun meaning illusory salvation is obscure; the sanctimonious person sense (schijnheilige) is covered by the other entry.
Scholastic method is just a facet of scholasticism and duplicates the other meaning.
Schonen is an archaic place name (Scania) that would only confuse a learner of common Dutch.
The gloss is a narrow, wrong version of the existing 'parent-in-law' meaning, so it duplicates it.
Archaic 'to see' is obscure and overlaps with 'to see mentally', so it only confuses a learner.
Schouwen does not mean to wag (that is wagging, "kwispelen"); it means to inspect, and the other meanings already cover that.
'To skew into an oblique' is awkward and essentially repeats 'to put crosswise' and 'to tilt'.
'To tilt' mostly duplicates the crosswise/skew idea and is obscure as a separate meaning.
It duplicates the scribe meaning, as schriftgeleerde has just one sense (a biblical scribe or scholar of scripture).
Schrooien is a rare dialectal/obsolete verb meaning 'to scrape' and 'cut to pieces' is a dubious duplicate that only confuses learners.
'Pigmented' is not a meaning of schub; the real meaning, scale, is already listed as another meaning.
Sensitiviteit means sensitivity, which is already listed as another meaning, so this 'sensibility' entry is a duplicate.
Sirocco is not a kiln; this archaic sense is wrong and only confuses learners, while the real meaning is listed separately.
'Dock worker' is unsupported and obscure, and the remaining meanings (loafer, unkempt person) already cover the word.
'Reaction' is only a weak sense of the same 'geen sjoege' usage (no response), and it overlaps with the other meaning, so it is better dropped.
Rare 'pertaining to slaves' sense is obscure and effectively overlaps with 'slavish', so it only confuses a learner.
'Unthinking' is just a nuance of 'slavish' (slaafs volgen), so it duplicates meaning 2.
'Sleepiness' (slaap hebben) is the same sense as 'sleep' and duplicates meaning 4.
boar's razor is a bad gloss and the real meaning, tusk, is already listed as another meaning.
Hoary is obscure and basically duplicates the worn/weathered sense of sleets, so drop it.
Slodderen means to be sloppy or hang loosely, not to chatter, so this meaning does not exist.
Archaic verb whose gloss 'to obtain' is wrong; the other meanings already cover sneaking and smuggling, so it only confuses learners.
condiment is nearly the same as the corrected flavor enhancer meaning, so it is a duplicate.
A single forged piece is essentially a repeat of the general sense of smeedwerk, so it is dropped.
'Spilled old rag' is a garbled duplicate of the 'mop' meaning.
This duplicates the other smoutebol meaning, since a smoutebol is simply an oliebol-type fried dough ball.
The Guelders silver coin is an obscure archaic meaning that would only confuse a learner.
Vague 'cooker' duplicates the more precise 'pressure cooker' meaning; actually snelkoker means a quick-boiling kettle/cooker, but the other item covers it.
Snelschrift means shorthand; 'pamphlet' is wrong and the correct meaning is already listed.
Snert means pea soup, and 'goopy mess' is not an established separate sense, so it is a duplicate or obscure.
Solderen means to solder; 'to reduce in price' is not a meaning of this word (confusion with a different word).
Soporatief means sleep-inducing, not simply boring, so this meaning is wrong and duplicates the soporific sense.
'Insurance-based agreement' is not a meaning of spaarkas; it is a mistaken gloss, and the real meaning is covered by item 4.
'Material used in casting' is not a real meaning of specie and is obscure and confusing.
'performable' is nearly the same as 'playable' (speelbaar, of music/roles), so it duplicates the other meaning.
Speelstad as a championship host city is a rare, obscure sense that would only confuse learners.
A speeltafel is a gaming table; 'console' is not a real meaning and the other sense already covers it.
Archaic word and 'brocket' duplicates the other meaning 'brocket deer'.
'someone who' is an incomplete fragment and duplicates the other meaning about someone who regrets a choice.
Spokerij means haunting or ghostly goings-on, not vulgar magic, and this duplicates the other meaning 'haunting'.
'Ghost animal' is a literal made-up reading, while the real meaning, tarsier (spookdier), is already listed as the other meaning.
The archaic 'to split' sense is obscure (spouwen as splitting is a rare dialect/technical use) and would only confuse a learner.
'Spouwer' is a rare derived noun, and this puker sense is a duplicate of the spitter meaning.
Antenna is not a real meaning of spriet; the word means a sprit (spar) or a small stick, so this is not a valid sense.
Lignite is not a meaning of spriet (that is bruinkool), so this sense does not exist.
Long is an adjective-like gloss that does not describe a noun meaning of spriet; the real senses are the sprit spar and a thin stick.
A plumbing-pipe branch is a niche technical sense that is essentially the same as the 'branch/offshoot' idea and confuses learners.
Plain 'tailfin' duplicates the more specific aircraft meaning listed in the other entry.
The vague gloss 'ride' duplicates the more precise meaning 'ride behind pacemaker' listed as item 3.
Steekpalm is holly (Ilex aquifolium); 'European box' is wrong (that is buxus), so this meaning does not exist and the holly entry covers it.
Stevigheid does not mean virtue; that meaning does not exist for this word.
Duplicates the other meaning stoic; the gloss is just a paraphrase of it.
The meaning 'disillusion' is only figurative (een koude douche), and stortbad itself means shower, so this does not exist for the word.
A 'flush of water' sense is not a real meaning of stortbad, which is a shower or downpour bath; it overlaps with the shower meaning.
Duplicate of the 'powerful thing' sense; the expression 'een straffe toebak' is kept in the other entry.
The gloss 'strong' is wrong for this noun and duplicates the other meanings 'no mean feat' and 'powerful thing'.  ('toebak' is also normally 'de'.)
Beach walker is just a literal rendering that duplicates the beachcomber meaning and adds nothing for a learner.
It duplicates the other strobed meaning (straw bed vs straw bedding).
It is a hamlet place name and the only meaning, but it is obscure and of no use to a learner; Stroet is not a common word.
'To tie' overlaps with the other meanings of stroppen, so it duplicates them.
'Ceruse' (white lead pigment) is an obscure archaic sense that only confuses learners and is unrelated to the ostrich meaning, so it is not a duplicate but is too obscure.
Shrubland essentially duplicates the brushwood/thicket meaning of struweel.
'To stunt' is just a near-duplicate of the other meaning, which covers the same sense.
'Dignity' is wrong for sultanaat, and the real meaning 'sultanate' is already listed as another meaning.
It is a clumsy duplicate of 'sense for language' in item 4.

column3: to turn into a tan colour
column4: Turning tan-coloured duplicates the 'to tan' sense and is not a distinct meaning.
Dutch 'tanig' means tawny/brownish-yellow or sallow-pale; 'colourless' is an obscure, overlapping sense covered by the others.
'Thin' is an obscure, dubious sense (leathery/lean) that only confuses learners and is not distinct from the main sense.
'In your region' is an obscure extension of 'at your house' and only confuses learners.
Archaic 'contradiction' sense is obscure; the other meaning (message in response, countermand) covers the word.
Archaic 'antipodean' sense duplicates the other meaning of tegenvoeter (counterpart/antipode) and only confuses learners.
Containing a purpose is just a paraphrase of teleological and duplicates the other meaning.
Torment is not a normal sense of temptatie, which means temptation, and that meaning is already listed.
'To tempt' is not a real meaning of tenteren (confusion with tenten/tentatie), so this meaning does not exist.
roji is an obscure Japanese-garden term, and the meaning "tea garden" is already listed, so this one only confuses a learner.
'Tist' as 'guy' or 'strange' is not an established Dutch word, so this meaning does not exist.
Tokken does not mean to pull; this meaning does not exist for the word.
Twitching is not a real meaning of tokken, so this meaning is invalid and unhelpful to a learner.
Toonaard means key or mode; the 'mode' gloss duplicates the other meaning 'key (classical mode)'.
Great woman is not an established informal meaning of topvrouw; it is a speculative reading of the compound.
Tovergodin means a sorceress goddess or enchantress, not simply a fairy, so this duplicates the other meaning and is dubious.
Toverlantaarn as an ugly person is not an actual usage and looks invented.
Tracery is a rare architectural sense that Dutch 'tracering' hardly carries (that is 'maaswerk'), and the main meaning 'tracing' is kept in the other item.
